overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、金融科技（2 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）。方法上以优化方法、实验方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（6 篇）、OpenAlex（4 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。

papers.title: ESG Performance, Corporate Governance, and Firm Value: Evidence from Global Oil and Gas Companies
papers.abstract:
Background: Global oil and gas companies face increasing pressure from the energy transition and rising ESG expectations, requiring firm value assessment beyond traditional financial indicators to include environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance and corporate governance quality.
Objective: This study examines the effect of ESG performance, board size, board independence, director busyness, board diversity, and ownership concentration on firm value, with financial performance as a mediating variable in global oil and gas companies during 2020–2024.
Methods: A quantitative panel data approach is employed, with firm value measured using price-to-book value (PBV). The analysis applies a Fixed Effects Model with Driscoll–Kraay standard errors, bootstrap mediation analysis, and robustness checks separating U.S. and non-U.S. firms.
Results: ESG performance has a positive but only marginally significant effect on firm value, which becomes insignificant after controlling for financial performance. Financial performance does not mediate the ESG–firm value relationship. Among governance variables, only board size has a significant positive effect on firm value, while board independence, director busyness, board diversity, and ownership concentration are not statistically significant. Robustness tests confirm overall consistency, with observable contextual differences across regions.
Conclusion: Firm value in global oil and gas companies is primarily driven by board size as a proxy for monitoring capacity and strategic resources, rather than ESG performance or other governance mechanisms, emphasizing the importance of aligning governance structure with operational efficiency and long-term value creation.
papers.summary_zh:
【公司金融】背景：全球石油和天然气公司面临着能源转型带来的日益增加的压力，以及日益提高的ESG（环境、社会和治理）期望。这要求企业在进行价值评估时，不能仅依赖传统的财务指标，还需考虑环境、社会和治理方面的表现以及公司治理质量。

目的：本研究探讨了2020年至2024年间，ESG表现、董事会规模、董事会独立性、董事工作负担、董事会多样性以及股权集中度对全球石油和天然气公司价值的影响，同时以财务表现为中介变量进行分析。

方法：本研究采用了定量面板数据分析方法，以市净率（PBV）作为企业价值的衡量指标。分析过程中运用了带有Driscoll–Kraay标准误差的固定效应模型、自助法中介分析，并对美国和非美国公司进行了区分处理以检验结果的稳健性。

结果：ESG表现对企业价值有正面影响，但这种影响仅具有边际显著性；在控制了财务表现后，这种影响不再显著。财务表现并未在ESG与企业价值之间的关系中起到中介作用。在治理变量中，只有董事会规模对企业价值有显著的正面影响，而董事会独立性、董事工作负担、董事会多样性和股权集中度则没有统计学上的显著意义。稳健性测试证实了研究结果的一致性，并发现不同地区之间存在一...。研究方法：面板数据、固定效应。

papers.title: Orientación vocacional y empleabilidad de la formación técnica y tecnológica en el Ecuador
papers.abstract: La formación técnica y tecnológica en el Ecuador enfrenta un desafío crítico: la desconexión entre el crecimiento de la oferta educativa y la calidad de la inserción laboral. A pesar de su potencial para dinamizar la productividad, los graduados suelen ingresar a un mercado marcado por la informalidad y la inestabilidad. Este estudio propone que la orientación vocacional, integrada estratégicamente al bienestar institucional, es la clave para fortalecer la empleabilidad. Mediante un enfoque cualitativo y el análisis de datos de 2025, se sugiere un modelo de acompañamiento integral que prioriza el desarrollo de power skills y proyectos de vida coherentes.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】厄瓜多尔的技术与职业教育面临着一个严峻的挑战：教育供给的增长与毕业生就业质量之间存在脱节。尽管这些教育资源具有提升生产力的潜力，但毕业生往往进入一个以非正规就业和就业不稳定为特征的市场。本研究认为，将职业指导战略性地融入学校整体发展体系中，是提高毕业生就业能力的关键。通过采用定性研究方法并分析2025年的相关数据，本研究提出了一种综合性的支持模式，该模式着重于培养学生的核心能力（即“power skills”）以及帮助他们规划清晰的人生目标。。

papers.title: Generative AI Availability, Grades, and Student Satisfaction at a Large University
papers.abstract: The spread of generative AI (GenAI) in higher education has raised concerns that students offload cognitive effort to AI, earning high grades without learning. If this "GenAI substitution hypothesis" is true, grades should rise disproportionately in GenAI-susceptible courses--those relying more on assessments like take-home problem sets and essays rather than in-class exams. Substitution could also affect student satisfaction, measured here as self-reported understanding and interest in the subject, which prior research links to assessments. We test the substitution hypothesis using syllabus and administrative data from a large U.S. university (2015-2025; 156,135 students; 87,936 course offerings). We measure courses' GenAI susceptibility using a human-validated LLM pipeline to extract assessment types from syllabi, and use a differences-in-differences design comparing outcomes across courses before and after ChatGPT's release, while modeling COVID-19 pandemic effects as either persistent or transient. We find no significant differential effect of GenAI availability on grades overall or among previously lower-performing students. Effects on self-reported understanding are likewise insignificant; effects on interest are significant only assuming transient pandemic effects. Our findings temper concerns that GenAI inflates grades and reduces students' satisfaction.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：生成式AI的普及是否导致学生依赖AI从而在不学习的情况下获得高分，并降低满意度？

🔬 研究方法：基于大型美国大学2015-2025年的数据，利用人类验证的LLM提取课程大纲中的评估类型，采用双重差分法对比ChatGPT发布前后的变化，并控制COVID-19疫情的影响。

📊 核心发现：研究发现GenAI的可用性对整体成绩及低表现学生群体均无显著影响；对自我报告的理解无显著影响，对兴趣的影响仅在假设疫情效应为暂定时才显著。

💡 应用价值：研究结果缓解了关于生成式AI导致成绩虚高和降低学生满意度的担忧。

papers.title: Group boarding for airplanes: benchmarking static policies and optimizing dynamic assignment with deep reinforcement learning
papers.abstract: Improving boarding efficiency reduces airplane turnaround time and improves passenger experience. Airlines typically assign passengers to a few sequential boarding groups using static seat-based rules. Yet arrivals, seat choices, and luggage are sequential and random, and a static rule ignores the seats earlier passengers have already taken. We propose the first dynamic formulation of boarding group assignment. As each passenger checks in, we observe earlier passengers' seats and groups, the current passenger's seat, and optional luggage information, then assign a group while keeping companions together. We formulate dynamic group assignment as a Markov decision process and solve it with reinforcement learning (RL). The policy uses a convolutional neural network to encode the checked-in seat-assignment state and is trained by proximal policy optimization. The reward balances total boarding time and average individual boarding time.   We benchmark the proposed RL policy against three companion-compatible static policies (back-to-front, modified Steffen, and alternating block) in an in-house simulator covering six single- and double-aisle layouts. Back-to-front with optimized group sizes achieves the shortest total boarding time and average individual boarding time among the static benchmarks across all layouts. The dynamic RL policy further outperforms it on both metrics in every layout. On a representative case, the RL policy outperforms the optimal back-to-front by up to 9.8\% in total boarding time and 22.8\% in average individual time. Sweeping the reward weight yields an approximate Pareto frontier for operator choice. Trained policies remain robust under out-of-distribution operating conditions, including varying load factors, companion sizes, and luggage loads.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】提高登机效率可以缩短飞机的周转时间并提升乘客的出行体验。航空公司通常根据固定的座位分配规则，将乘客划分为若干个依次登机的小组。然而，乘客的到达顺序、座位选择以及行李情况都是随机且有序的，而固定规则并未考虑到先前乘客已经占用的座位。我们提出了首个动态的登机小组分配方案：在每位乘客办理登机手续时，系统会记录先前乘客的座位和所属小组信息、当前乘客的座位情况以及可选的行李信息，然后在确保乘客同行者能够相邻就座的前提下为其分配相应的小组。我们将这种动态分配过程建模为一个马尔可夫决策过程，并通过强化学习（RL）算法进行优化。该算法利用卷积神经网络对乘客的登机信息进行编码，并通过近端策略优化方法进行训练；奖励机制兼顾了整体登机时间和每位乘客的平均登机时间。我们在自主研发的模拟器中，将所提出的强化学习策略与三种基于固定规则的登机方案（从前到后、改进版的Steffen方案以及交替登机方案）进行了对比测试。结果显示，在所有布局类型中，采用优化小组分配方式的“从前到后”方案均实现了最短的总登机时间和平均登机时间；而动态强化学习策略在各项指标上均显著优于其他静态方案。在典型案例中，该策略的总登机时间最多...。研究方法：神经网络、优化方法。

papers.title: Research on the Impact of Digital Inclusive Finance on Industrial Green Development Efficiency
papers.venue: Asian Journal of Economics Business and Accounting
papers.abstract:
Aims: To quantify industrial green development efficiency across 30 Chinese provinces from 2010 to 2024 and examine how digital inclusive finance affects this efficiency, with particular attention to the underlying mechanisms, heterogeneity across regions and firm types, and key policy-related factors. 
Study Design: An empirical longitudinal panel study using annual province-level data. 
Place and Duration of Study: China (30 provinces), 2010–2024. 
Methodology: Industrial green development efficiency was calculated using the SBM-DDF model and the GML index. Digital inclusive finance was measured using a composite index. Panel regressions were employed to estimate the effect of digital inclusive finance on green efficiency. Heterogeneity analyses compared eastern, central, and western provinces; the periods before and after the “Internet+” policy; and enterprise types, including large versus small and medium-sized enterprises and state-owned versus private enterprises. Robustness checks included replacing the dependent variable, winsorising continuous variables, and using a one-period lag of digital inclusive finance. 
Results: Industrial green development efficiency increased steadily, with a compound annual growth rate of 3.6%. The decomposition indicates that technological progress accounted for 66.8% of the improvement, whereas gains in technical efficiency were slower. Digital inclusive finance had a positive and statistically significant effect on green efficiency, with a stronger effect in eastern provinces. Following the implementation of the “Internet+” policy, the estimated effect increased by 40.2%. The enabling effect was stronger for large and state-owned industrial firms than for small and medium-sized and private firms. 
Conclusion: Digital inclusive finance supports industrial green transformation in China. Policies should strengthen region-specific design, provide more targeted support for green investment, and reduce financing barriers for smaller and private industrial firms to advance the dual-carbon goals and high-quality development.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融科技】**研究目的**：量化2010至2024年间中国30个省份的工业绿色发展效率，并探讨数字普惠金融对这一效率的影响，重点关注其作用机制、地区及企业类型的差异性以及关键的政策相关因素。  

**研究设计**：采用年度省级数据的实证纵向面板研究方法。  

**研究地点与时间范围**：中国（30个省份），2010–2024年。  

**研究方法**：利用SBM-DDF模型和GML指数计算工业绿色发展效率；通过综合指数衡量数字普惠金融的发展水平；通过面板回归分析数字普惠金融对绿色效率的影响。同时进行异质性分析，比较东部、中部和西部省份的差异，以及“互联网+”政策实施前后的变化；还分析了不同类型企业（大型企业、中型企业、国有企业与私营企业）之间的差异。为确保研究结果的稳健性，采取了替换因变量、对连续变量进行Winsor处理以及使用数字普惠金融的一期滞后数据等方法。  

**研究结果**：工业绿色发展效率稳步提升，年均增长率为3.6%。分解结果显示，技术进步贡献了66.8%的效率提升，而技术效率的提高相对较慢。数字普惠金融对绿色效率具有显著的正向影响，且在东部省份的作用更为明显。实施“...。研究方法：面板回归、回归分析。

papers.title: Does Berger and Udell (1998) financial life-cycle theory hold for loan interest rates?
papers.abstract: Financial life-cycle theory outlines how the firm size-age continuum shapes the financing choices of firms in terms of the sources of finance available to them and is rooted in information-based problems that impact with greater severity on smaller and younger firms. Logically, it follows that these features should also be present in banks’ loan interest rate setting processes and result in higher loan interest rate offers to smaller and younger firms. Most studies have explored size and age effects independently, and this has rarely been explored simultaneously. In this study, we consider how the interaction of firm size and age from micro new firms to large well-established firms impacts on loan interest rates. Using a large loan contract dataset for the UK, we find that the estimated average interest rate difference at the extremes is 5.43%, but that new firms of any size class tend to receive lower interest rate offers than early-stage firms of the same size class. We conclude that the financial life-cycle theory can also be extended to loan interest rate setting, but that lenders tend to subsidise loans to new firms which suggests a long-term lock-in strategy.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】财务生命周期理论阐述了企业规模与年龄的关联如何影响企业的融资决策，特别是它们可获得的资金来源。这一理论基于信息不对称问题，而这类问题对规模较小、成立时间较短的企业影响更为严重。因此，这些因素理应也会体现在银行的贷款利率设定过程中，导致小型、年轻企业获得更高的贷款利率。以往大多数研究都是分别探讨企业规模和年龄对贷款利率的影响，而很少将两者结合起来进行分析。在本研究中，我们考察了从微型新企业到大型成熟企业，企业规模与年龄的相互作用对贷款利率的影响。利用英国的大型贷款合同数据集，我们发现极端情况下的贷款利率平均差异为5.43%；不过，任何规模类别的新企业获得的贷款利率通常都低于同规模类别的初创企业。研究结果表明，财务生命周期理论同样适用于贷款利率的设定，但贷款机构倾向于为新企业提供较低利率的贷款，这可能暗示着一种长期锁定策略的存在。。

papers.title: Multi-scale contextual modeling and fine-grained adaptive fusion for real-time surface defect detection
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Surface defect detection in steel strips requires both accurate recognition and efficient inference under complex industrial backgrounds. Existing methods still encounter difficulties in modeling scale-varied defects, preserving fine-grained defect cues, and aligning multi-level features efficiently. To address these issues, we propose CDF-YOLO, a real-time detection framework that integrates multi-scale contextual modeling and fine-grained adaptive fusion on the YOLOv12 baseline. Specifically, a Dilated Context Pyramid Bottleneck (C2f_DCPB) is introduced to enhance contextual representation through parallel dilated branches; a Fine-grained Adaptive Fusion module (FAN_Block) is embedded into the high-resolution path to strengthen local texture and structural-detail representation; and DySample is adopted to improve content-adaptive upsampling for multi-scale feature fusion. Experiments on the NEU-DET dataset show that CDF-YOLO achieves an mAP50 of 95.4% and 101.3 FPS under the adopted test protocol, while cross-dataset evaluation on DeepPCB further indicates improved generalization performance. These results suggest that CDF-YOLO provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off on public industrial defect datasets. Nevertheless, validation on larger-scale production-line data and further optimization for edge deployment remain necessary for practical industrial application.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
在复杂的工业环境中，对钢带表面缺陷的检测既需要准确的识别能力，也需要高效的推理机制。现有方法在处理尺度变化较大的缺陷、保留细微的缺陷特征以及高效整合多级特征方面仍存在困难。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了CDF-YOLO这一实时检测框架，该框架在YOLOv12的基础上融合了多尺度上下文建模与细粒度自适应融合技术。具体而言，通过引入扩张型上下文金字塔瓶颈（C2f_DCPB）利用并行扩张分支增强上下文信息表示；将细粒度自适应融合模块（FAN_Block）嵌入高分辨率路径以提升局部纹理和结构细节的表征能力；并采用DySample算法实现内容自适应的上采样，从而优化多尺度特征融合效果。在NEU-DET数据集上的实验表明，CDF-YOLO在所采用的测试协议下达到了95.4%的mAP50值和101.3帧每秒的检测速度；而在DeepPCB数据集上的跨数据集评估进一步证明了其良好的泛化性能。这些结果表明，CDF-YOLO在公共工业缺陷数据集上实现了精度与效率之间的良好平衡。然而，为了在实际工业应用中取得更好的效果，仍需在更大规模的生产线数据上进行验证，并对算法进行进一步优化以适应边缘计算环境。。研究方法：实验方法、优化方法。

papers.title: Starved by scarcity: A three scarcities framework and decision roadmap for medical named entity recognition in low-resource languages
papers.abstract: Named entity recognition (NER) is a foundational task in medical natural language processing (NLP), enabling the extraction of clinically relevant information from unstructured text and supporting downstream applications such as information retrieval and clinical decision support. While pre-trained language models such as BioBERT, ClinicalBERT, and PubMedBERT have achieved state-of-the-art performance for English medical NER, progress in low-resource languages remains fragmented and uneven, even though healthcare systems worldwide generate vast amounts of textual data whose value depends on the availability of language technologies. Existing surveys provide valuable overviews but largely treat low-resource settings as a single category, overlooking important differences in the constraints practitioners face. To address this gap, we conducted a systematic review of 46 studies on medical NER in low-resource languages published since 2020. Based on the synthesized evidence, we introduce the three scarcities framework, which conceptualizes low-resource medical NLP as the interaction among data, model, and infrastructure scarcities. We also propose a practitioner-oriented decision roadmap that maps appropriate modeling and data augmentation strategies to different resource configurations. Our review develops a structured taxonomy of approaches, including cross-lingual transfer, in-domain pre-training, annotation projection, back-translation, and large language model-based synthetic data generation, and shows that the effectiveness of techniques depends less on the method itself than on the underlying scarcity profile. We also identify persistent weaknesses in evaluation practices, including inconsistent reporting and limited use of statistical significance testing.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】命名实体识别（NER）是医学自然语言处理（NLP）中的基础任务，它能够从非结构化文本中提取具有临床意义的信息，并为信息检索和临床决策支持等下游应用提供支持。尽管预训练的语言模型（如BioBERT、ClinicalBERT和PubMedBERT）在英语医学NER领域已经取得了先进的性能，但在资源匮乏的语言中的进展仍然零散且不均衡。尽管全球医疗系统产生了大量文本数据，而这些数据的价值取决于语言技术的可用性。现有的研究综述提供了宝贵的概述，但大多将资源匮乏的环境视为一个统一的类别，忽略了从业者在实际应用中面临的种种差异。为了解决这一问题，我们对2020年以来发表的46项关于资源匮乏语言中医学NER的研究进行了系统性回顾。基于综合分析，我们提出了“三种稀缺性框架”（three scarcities framework），该框架将资源匮乏的医学NLP问题归结为数据、模型和基础设施三个方面的不足。我们还提出了一份面向从业者的决策路线图，根据不同的资源状况推荐相应的建模和数据增强策略。我们的研究建立了一个结构化的方法分类体系，包括跨语言迁移、领域内预训练、注释投影、反向翻译以及基于大型语言模型...。研究方法：大语言模型、自然语言处理、调查数据。

papers.title: The Evolution of Digital Search: From Blue Links to Delegated Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Digital search is undergoing a fundamental transformation from a human-driven process of discovery to an agent-mediated system of delegated decision-making. In the traditional model of digital search, users translate intent into keyword-based queries, evaluate ranked lists of links, and execute decisions outside the search interface. In an AI-native world, users express goals in natural language, agents interpret these intentions, and outcomes are returned as recommendations or executed decisions. This shift moves search from a link-based user interface to an embedded system component, with implications for transparency, competition, and monetization. The resulting system design problem raises key questions about information quality and access, trust, incentive alignment, and market structure. Early evidence from experimental agent-mediated marketplaces and economic theory suggests that small design choices, such as how stakeholders access information, how options are surfaced, and how actions are executed, have first-order effects on efficiency, competition, and the welfare of consumers and firms. We propose that the future of search will be determined not by incremental improvements in ranking algorithms and natural-language interfaces, but by the design of open, transparent, and competitive agentic systems that govern how decisions are made and how markets operate, highlighting a set of grand challenges at the intersection of AI, economics, and system design.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】数字搜索正在经历一场根本性的变革：它正从一种由人类驱动的发现过程，转变为一种由智能代理中介的、基于委托决策的系统。在传统的数字搜索模式中，用户将搜索意图转化为基于关键词的查询，评估链接的排名列表，并在搜索界面之外做出决策。而在以人工智能为核心的技术环境中，用户用自然语言表达目标，智能代理解读这些意图，最终以推荐结果或实际执行的决定形式返回给用户。这种转变使得搜索功能从基于链接的用户界面演变为一个嵌入式的系统组件，这对搜索的透明度、竞争格局以及商业模式都产生了深远影响。由此带来的系统设计问题引发了关于信息质量与获取方式、信任机制、激励机制匹配度以及市场结构等方面的关键议题。来自实验性智能代理中介市场和经济理论的初步证据表明，一些细微的设计决策（例如利益相关者获取信息的方式、展示选项的途径以及执行操作的具体流程）会对搜索效率、市场竞争以及消费者和企业的福祉产生直接的影响。我们认为，搜索技术的未来并非取决于排名算法或自然语言界面的渐进式改进，而是取决于那些开放、透明且具有竞争性的智能代理系统的设计——这些系统将决定决策的制定方式以及市场的运作机制。这凸显了人工智能、经济学与系统设计交叉...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Stochastic Potential Choices and Outcomes
papers.abstract: Applied econometricians typically model each individual as having fixed outcomes under treatment and control and, in instrumental-variables (IV) settings, fixed treatment decisions under each value of the instrument. This paper asks what changes when outcomes and treatment allocations or choices are stochastic at the individual level. In the model, each individual has a stable (but possibly stochastic) response type consisting of two objects: a treatment choice probability under each state and a potential outcome distribution under each treatment-state pair. These stochastic potential outcomes change the interpretation of some familiar estimators. For instance, in the deterministic IV model, the estimand identifies treatment effect only for compliers - those whose treatment status switches with the instrument. Under stochastic treatment allocation or choice there is no such subgroup: the estimand averages effects over all individuals, weighting each by how much the instrument, policy, or assignment rule moves their probability of treatment. The paper then gives an information-based foundation for stochastic choice, in which individuals act on expected gains given their information.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】应用计量经济学家通常将每个个体视为在处理组和对照组下具有固定结果的主体；在工具变量（Instrumental Variables, IV）模型中，也假设在工具变量的每个取值下个体的治疗决策是固定的。本文探讨了当个体层面的结果和治疗分配或选择具有随机性时，相关模型和结论会发生怎样的变化。在该模型中，每个个体都具有一种稳定的（但可能是随机的）反应特征，这种特征包括两个方面：在每种状态下选择接受治疗的概率，以及在接受某种治疗状态下的潜在结果分布。这些随机性的潜在结果改变了某些常见统计量的解释方式。例如，在确定性工具变量模型中，估计量仅能识别那些因工具变量变化而改变治疗状态的个体的治疗效果；而在随机治疗分配或选择的情况下，不再存在这样的子群体——估计量是对所有个体治疗效果的平均值，每个个体的权重取决于工具变量、政策或分配规则对其接受治疗概率的影响程度。本文进一步为随机选择行为提供了基于信息的经济学理论基础，即个体会根据自身所掌握的信息来做出决策，以追求预期的收益。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Uniformly Consistent Semi-nonparametric Demand Estimation with Micro-Data
papers.abstract: This paper develops a profiled sieve minimum-distance estimator for a semi-nonparametric differentiated-products demand model with micro-level choice data. Building on Berry and Haile (2024), the estimator uses within-market variation in consumer covariates to recover a flexible consumer-heterogeneity function and market-specific composite intercepts. Excluded price instruments then separate these intercepts into a flexible price-side function and structural demand shocks. The main statistical challenge is that the number of profiled market intercepts grows with the number of markets. I show that, when both the number of markets and the minimum within-market sample size grow, this profiling step is asymptotically negligible and the common structural functions are uniformly consistently estimated. Monte Carlo evidence supports the consistency result and illustrates the value of flexible price-side estimation for counterfactual demand analysis.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文针对包含微观层面选择数据的半非参数差异化产品需求模型，提出了一种基于市场特征的筛选最小距离估计方法。该方法在Berry和Haile（2024）的研究基础上，利用市场内部消费者协变量的差异来推断出灵活的消费者异质性函数以及市场特定的复合截距。随后，通过排除价格变量，将这些截距分解为灵活的价格效应部分和结构性需求冲击。主要的统计挑战在于：随着市场数量的增加，需要分析的市场特征截距数量也会相应增加。研究表明，当市场数量和每个市场内的样本量同时增加时，这种基于市场特征的筛选步骤在统计上可以忽略不计，从而能够一致地估计出共同的结构性函数。蒙特卡洛模拟结果验证了这一一致性结论，并展示了灵活价格效应估计在反事实需求分析中的重要作用。。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟。

papers.title: Using Pre-Trends for Inference in Difference-in-Differences
papers.abstract: Difference-in-differences (DID) are sometimes estimated with many pre-treatment periods. In such settings, the observed pre-treatment outcome evolutions provide direct information about the magnitude of shocks that could also occur after treatment. This paper proposes a simple inference procedure that uses those pre-trends as the reference distribution for the post-treatment DID. The procedure is closely related to existing conformal inference procedures, but its DID-specific predictor leads to a distinct identifying restriction. Existing procedures assume parallel trends, while this paper's procedure does not require parallel trends.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】差异中的差异（Difference-in-differences, DID）估计有时会使用多个处理前的时期数据。在这种情况下，观察到的处理前结果变化可以直接反映处理后可能出现的冲击效应的幅度。本文提出了一种简单的推断方法，该方法利用这些处理前的趋势数据作为处理后DID效应的参考分布。该方法与现有的共形推断（conformal inference）方法密切相关，但其特有的预测变量特征带来了不同的识别限制：现有方法假设各时期的趋势是平行的，而本文的方法则不要求各时期的趋势必须平行。。研究方法：双重差分。
